parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to N, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the N-1 layer is returned.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline node. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the node ID.

parameters.name: PipelineRunId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

parameters.name: TokenId
parameters.description: The ID of the shared pipeline job.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

*   Logical (default): the logical node. The nodes submitted by users are logical nodes.
*   Physical: the physical node on which a container is deployed for executing specific logic. A logical node is converted to a physical node when the logical node runs in the background.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-status --pipeline-run-id flow-rbvg5wzljzjhc90000 --node-id node-kdkfkfds0000 --depth 2 --type Logical --token-id 'https://pai.console.aliyun.com/0regionId=cn-hangzhou_workspaceId=102000000_mode=noSidebar#/paiflow/pipeline-runs/flow-6y70000000Token=eyJ0e000000' --region cn-hangzhou
